channel.title: World Stock News | Real-Time Stock Market News & Financial Intelligence
channel.description: Institutional-grade stock market coverage, Wall Street analysis, real-time macroeconomic reports, and cryptocurrency intelligence.

item.title: Why investors should be skeptical of a potential Tesla-SpaceX merger
item.dc:creator: Elena Rostova
item.description: Wall Street is all abuzz over a possible merger between Tesla and SpaceX. But there is a high probability that such a merger would be a bad idea.

item.title: Trump says data centers should generate their own electricity — but experts say only states can mandate that
item.dc:creator: Marcus Vance
item.description: The president’s statement comes as a voter backlash against the facilities intensifies ahead of the midterm elections.

item.title: Oil is now flowing out of the Persian Gulf like before the Iran war. Why prices may still not come down anytime soon.
item.dc:creator: Siddharth Mehta
item.description: Oil flows out of the Persian Gulf in October nearly returned to levels seen before the start of the Iran war, but traders remain wary about a fragile recovery.

item.title: ‘I don’t feel sorry for myself’: I’m 64 and will be renting for the rest of my life. Is that so bad?
item.dc:creator: Claire Montclaire
item.description: “I married a wonderful man with a good income. He left his job due to health issues and suffered a massive stroke at 53.”

item.title: 7 healthcare stocks that stand out as investors pay up for the sector
item.dc:creator: Elena Rostova
item.description: Investors have pushed the healthcare sector to a record high, and some favored stocks have high projected revenue growth rates through 2028.

item.title: ‘Super’ El Niño may soon make your coffee super expensive
item.dc:creator: Elena Rostova
item.description: Agricultural markets around the world are already dealing with record-high diesel prices and high fertilizer costs. A “super” El Niño is almost guaranteed to make matters worse for farmers and consumers.

item.title: Medicare is a bargain. What America can’t afford is private health insurance.
item.dc:creator: Marcus Vance
item.description: Private insurance costs way more for the same results — or worse.

item.title: Polymarket traders see a 10% chance the AI bubble bursts before New Year’s Day

item.description: For investors worried that the runaway artificial-intelligence trade might be about to hit the skids, prediction markets are already starting to reflect that anxiety.

item.dc:creator: Claire Montclaire

item.title: Moderna is about to release the trial results for its cancer vaccine. A lot is riding on this data.

item.title: Anthropic is AI trade's last big hope for a major IPO this year
item.dc:creator: Elena Rostova
item.description: On Kalshi, Anthropic is seen as the last major IPO in 2026 after OpenAI delayed its public market debut. Others have postponed too.
